findings.summary: The new __next__ override on the sys.stdin class raises EOFError when input is exhausted, so ordinary iteration like for-loops, list(sys.stdin) and csv.reader(sys.stdin) crashes instead of ending.

Prompts now raise EOFError (becoming Abort, exit code 1) when input runs out instead of returning an empty string so defaults apply; this behavior change forced test edits, and the test_chain.py edit hides the abort rather than fixing the test input.
